content: If a SOME/IP segment is successfully received with Offset Field set to 0, the SOME/IP TP module shall • Start the Rx timeout time defined by SomeIpTpRxTimeoutTime. • Call the API PduR_SomeIpTpStartOfReception() with the PDU ID derived from the parameter SomeIpTpRxSduRef and the TpSduLength set to '0'.
